phase: Five-view inspection: anatomy and garment fit
note: The face, proportions, and collar are closer. Side and back checks exposed overly sharp knee bends, thighs intersecting the shorts, visible sleeve-root gaps, and abrupt back-hair roots. The next pass rebuilds rounded knees and fits the shorts to the actual posed thighs.

journal.title: First assembled model: lighting correction needed
journal.notes: The complete original model renders and exports. Visual review found severe highlight clipping, one eye partly obscured by the fringe, and a cylindrical garment silhouette. The next pass corrects shading and opens both eyes before judging finer detail.

journal.title: Colors restored; both eyes readable
journal.notes: Bounded cel illumination restores the lavender hair and original cat print. Both eyes are visible. Close inspection reveals a hair-cap intersection in the forehead opening, an overly rounded collar, stiff shirt shaping, and insufficiently asymmetric back hair. These are the next geometry corrections.
